title: Declare fixed and varying harness experiment dimensions
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs every harness experiment to state which configuration axes are fixed and which vary, with a reproducible digest on traces. Accepts FineEnvs harness-overfitting axes guidance[^fineenvs-dims].
implementation: `ExperimentDimensions` and `require_dimension_trace_fields` in `mechaharness.experiment_dimensions` canonicalize fixed/varying axes into a digest.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
